sources.snippet: LaMa-ONNX — overview Overview LaMa-ONNX is an ONNX port of the original PyTorch big-lama inpainting model, maintained by Carve. The model uses Fourier Convolutions to perform resolution-robust image inpainting—removing unwanted objects or filling masked regions with plausible content.
